title.narrative: Community HIV and AIDS Care and Treatment activity

description.narrative: Project HOPE is implementing the Community HIV Care and Treatment (CHCT) program, which aims to expand access to comprehensive HIV prevention, care and treatment services. This USAID-funded five-year program is implementing community-based targeted index-case testing to contribute to the UNAIDS 90-90-90 target and help end the AIDS epidemic in Ethiopia.
